features: AI-POWERED AUTO TRACKING: Don’t miss a moment. With 6 TOPS AI performance and an 8-core processor, our advanced AI auto-tracking system functions like a dedicated cameraman—automatically tracking players and the ball in soccer, basketball, and team sports with accurate dual-lens precision. Great for coaches and parents capturing every highlight.

ULTRA-CLEAR 4K VIDEO WITH AI-ASSISTED DUAL LENS: Capture every play in crystal-clear 4K with a dual-lens system that combines a 4K recording lens and an AI-assisted lens for smarter tracking performance. Ideal for game review, player development, and recruitment videos.

INSTANT LIVE STREAMING & SHARING: Stream games in real time with built-in Wi-Fi and share the action instantly with family, fans, and your community. A simple setup makes it easy to go live and stay connected from anywhere.

ALL-IN-ONE, SIDELINE-READY DESIGN: This compact all-in-one camera integrates AI tracking, 4K video, and durable outdoor performance in one device—no extra gimbal or bulky equipment needed. The IPX5 water-resistant design is built for real sideline conditions.

FLEXIBLE STORAGE & EASY MOUNTING: Features a standard 1/4” screw mount for fast setup on compatible tripods. Supports cloud service and microSD card storage, with microSD card required for recording and sold separately.
description: Tired of missing your child's winning goal because you were busy holding a phone? Introducing the XbotGo Falcon, the revolutionary AI-powered sports camera designed to liberate parents and coaches. Imagine setting up a tripod on the sidelines, pressing "Start," and walking away to enjoy the game. Our dual-lens AI technology intelligently follows the flow of the match, ensuring the camera is always where the action is—whether it's a fast break on the basketball court or a long pass on the soccer field. Why choose XbotGo Falcon? Unlike traditional action cams that require manual panning, the Falcon uses autonomous tracking to deliver professional-looking broadcast footage. With 4K resolution, every jersey number and tactical movement is captured in sharp detail, making it an essential tool for sports performance analysis and creating scouting reels. Stream, Save, and Celebrate. With integrated Wi-Fi and subscription-free live streaming, you can broadcast games to friends and family instantly. The rugged, IPX5-rated housing means the game goes on, rain or shine. Transform how you record, watch, and improve your game with the smartest sports cameraman in your pocket.
